interpretation: Instrumented current-code diagnostics with frozen continuous-loss controls. All 30 GPU samples match their paired baseline warmup and measured trajectory array hashes. The learned32 arm reuses request-owned capacity state from warmup; it does not establish cold-request speedup. Geant4 native process timers include initialization and logging, unlike GPU warm transport timers. Different physical models and no joint accuracy qualification; no equal-precision or whole-application speed ratio. Initial failed W setup attempts and co-resident pilot job 2627 are excluded. Peak VRAM and instruction-level occupancy/stalls were not measured. Generic evidence paths replace operator-specific metadata.
